messages:
Ari: Quick intake — partner submitted a new decoder model 'marigold-10b' (10B params, 8k context). Requesting bring-up checklist: quant experiments (AWQ + int8), smoke perf (latency/cost), full evals vs our current default, catalog metadata, model card, docs + short announcement. Target staged canary next Tue (2026-04-06). Owners?

Sam: P2 priority. Sounds reasonable to slot after the current dedicated run. We need an eval matrix: MMLU, TruthBench-v2, regen tests, and a simple hallucination probe. Also: where are weights + license? @Ari

Ari: weights: s3://redwood-partners/marigold/10b/v1/checkpoint.pt. License: BSD-3 (permissive). Owners proposal: ML=Ari, Docs=Lena, Infra=Nate, DevEx=DevEx bot for SDK snippets. Checklist: 
- quant: AWQ -> candidate, then INT8 baseline
- evals: MMLU, TruthBench-v2, regen/consistency, safety tags
- perf: latency, p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens
- catalog: metadata + model card PR
- release: staged canary -> gradual rollout with fallback

Lena: I can draft the catalog entry and short release note. Need sample outputs, model card fields (training data summary, known failure modes). Can we get a small safety eval dump?

Nate: I'll reserve a small staging pool (1x A100-equivalent) and spin up a canary slot for the smoke tests. Ping me when quant artifacts are ready.

Ari: quick quant command I'll run for AWQ and int8 experiments:
```
python tools/quantize.py --model s3://redwood-partners/marigold/10b/v1 --algo awq --out /tmp/mg-awq --bits 4
python tools/quantize.py --model s3://redwood-partners/marigold/10b/v1 --algo int8 --out /tmp/mg-int8 --calibrate --batch 16
```

infra-bot: infra: staging pool reservation created (pool-id: staging-mg-01), ETA for env ready 20m.

Ari: early AWQ smoke results (high level): perplexity ~baseline (+0.4%), regen quality drop ~1.3% on internal regen set, TruthBench hallucination metric increased by 0.9 percentage points (small but noted). INT8 run shows ~1.1x latency improvement but hallucination uplift larger (~2.6ppt). Full evals running; will post artifacts.

Sam: Good signal-check. Gate proposal: accept AWQ candidate if LLR/QA drop <=2% and hallucination delta <=1ppt; latency <=1.2x baseline. If AWQ fails, we keep INT8 as fallback only if hallucination delta acceptable. Otherwise hold.

Lena: I'll start the catalog PR and include a "recommended quant profile" section with AWQ candidate note. Draft ETA EOD tomorrow. DevEx-bot, can you generate example SDK call for streaming and embeddings once we have the model id?

devex-bot: noted — will auto-populate SDK snippets once the model_id is created in catalog.

Nate: staging jobs queued. Command I'll use for smoke (for ops trace):
```
redwoodctl run --pool staging-mg-01 --image inference:canary --model marigold-10b --cmd "./smoke_runner --tokens 200 --concurrency 4"
```

Ari: attaching quick summary once full eval finishes. Next steps: 1) finish AWQ experiments (Ari), 2) full eval artifacts uploaded to /artifacts/marigold/10b/v1 (Ari), 3) catalog PR (Lena), 4) schedule canary (Nate). @Sam can we lock the rollout window after the AWQ candidate passes?

Sam: yes — lock window after AWQ pass. If pass, target canary Wed and announce public hosted availability after 1-week canary with metrics. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: job 4567 started (smoke).
